@@U04051@@
Me? No, you. This time
you're the commander-in-chief.

@@U04053@@
And wouldn't that be something!
Ordering about in a language I don't even know!

@@U04055@@
Leave that to your General Staff
and you're home free.
Now,
knowing the mess that war can be,
I’ve anticipated and formed a war council
out of mountain manpower as old as earth.
He’s a lucky man who can get them in harness.

@@U04057@@
‘

@@U04058@@
Who are those armed men there?
Have you stirred up the mountain folk?

@@U04060@@
No, but, like Peter Quince,
the very quintessence of the rabble.

@@U04061@@
(Enter THREE VIOLENT GIANTS.)

@@U04063@@
Ah, here come my boys now!
As you will note,
they differ widely in age, clothing
and the arms they wear.
I think you'll find they'll serve you well.

@@U04064@@
(To the audience.)

@@U04065@@
Everyone these days delights seeing knights in armor;
and since these brutes are allegorical,
they'll just likely manage to please all the more.
translation:
@@U04051@@
我？不，你。这次
你是总司令。

@@U04053@@
那不会是什么东西吧！
用我什至不知道的语言订购！

@@U04055@@
把它留给你的总参谋部
你就可以自由回家了。
现在，
知道战争可能造成的混乱，
我预见并组建了一个战争委员会
来自与地球一样古老的山地人力。
他是一个幸运的人，能够把它们绑在安全带上。

@@U04057@@
'

@@U04058@@
那里的那些武装人员是谁？
你把山里人都搅动了吗？

@@U04060@@
不，但是，就像彼得·昆斯一样，
这是乌合之众的本质。

@@U04061@@
（三个暴力巨人上。）

@@U04063@@
啊，我的孩子们现在来了！
正如你会注意到的，
他们的年龄、衣着差异很大
以及他们佩戴的武器。
我想你会发现他们会很好地为你服务。

@@U04064@@
（对观众。）

@@U04065@@
如今，每个人都喜欢看到身穿盔甲的骑士；
由于这些野兽是寓言性的，
他们很可能会设法取悦更多人。
